absences: OBBBA incentives.points (2034 begin-construction date for nuclear under 45Y/48E, three-year phase-out, 10% nuclear energy community adder): primary text of Public Law 119-21 read in three windows on govinfo (offsets 640000-900000). Sec. 70512 amends 45Y with 2025, 2026, 2027 and 2032 dates; the nuclear provisions I could read amend 45(b)(11) with a 0.17% MSA employment test. The 2034 clause was not located in the text read. Only a Morgan Lewis summary dated 2025-07-24 confirmed the shipped wording, which is outside the 60-day confirmation window, so no verdict was written. Needs a main-session read of the full Title VII text.

NEI 2019 Cost Competitiveness of Micro-Reactors for Remote Markets (costs.json microreactor_lcoe[0] and [1], FOAK 140-410 and NOAK 90-330 $/MWh): nei.org returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch and the search summary did not surface the figures. Not verified.

TUGLIQ Raglan public completion report (displaced_alternatives[0], industrial self-generation $0.25-0.60/kWh): WebFetch saved the PDF but returned no text; no PDF text extractor is available in the system python. Not verified.

Diesel breakeven threshold $1.50/litre (displaced_alternatives[2], ScienceDirect S2210670723002317): paywalled, not fetched. Threshold is a 2023 modelled result, so no current-price check was possible.

Blykalla / Urenco HALEU supply agreement, dated 2026-11-16 (web-leads lead; SEALER is 55 MWe, outside the 1-20 MW band). Fetched Blykalla press release confirms a supply agreement for enrichment and says no quantities; it does not say whether the agreement is binding. Not filed as an item because a verbatim fetched quote could not be confirmed. Main session should decide whether it is fuel-supply context.

HALEU enrichment and deliveries, Nov 2026: searches found no dated event after 2026-11-16. Latest items are already on skip/news.json (Centrus-Oklo 2026-11-13, Centrus Piketon centrifuge 2026-10-30, DOE no further Centrus options 2026-11-04).

DOE loan and financing actions, Nov 2026: none found in window. The June 2026 $17.5B conditional loans (AP1000 supply chain) and October 2026 Constellation uprate loan are large-reactor or existing-fleet, outside the band and not fuel.

checks.claim: Optimized design, with PTC (U.S. only): low_mwh 48.21, high_mwh 78.32, USD/MWh
checks.evidence: arXiv:2506.13361 abstract, latest version v2 submitted 2025-12-19 (Abdussami et al., Univ. of Michigan): LCOEs of $48.21/MWh to $78.32/MWh when supported by the PTC, and the PTC reduces LCOE by 22-24%. The abstract gives no $/kW capital range. The shipped derived unsubsidised band ($63-103/MWh) was not checked here.
